source_quality.notes: text layer covers all 37 pages; the security, politics and economics formulas were read from the raster, the rest from prose after the view budget ran out

task_reconstruction: Build a fragility score from security, politics, economics and climate, split climate into a slow part and an extreme part, find the moment a country's resistance crosses a line, and extend the score to cities and continents.

contributions.summary: a score with four fields on top and extreme weather underneath
a resistance built from land, income and security, each against its own benchmark
a tipping point defined as the moment the resistance crosses a line
a continent score weighted by each country's resistance

land area stands in for the stock of resources
